stories.title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
stories.description: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.

stories.title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
stories.description: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.

stories.title: X expands its ‘Gametime’ sports hub beyond the NFL, starting with MLB
stories.description: X is turning its NFL-focused Gametime feature into a year-round sports destination, starting with MLB and with other professional leagues to follow.

stories.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies, union says
stories.description: Maricarmen Abascal, 87, was forcibly removed on a stretcher from her apartment of more than 70 years in September.

stories.title: Boots sold in £7bn deal to Canadian billionaire family
stories.description: The sale of the High Street chain was announced on Wednesday.

stories.title: Chris Mason: Tories united behind Badenoch - but party still needs to win over voters
stories.description: Kemi Badenoch has the support of her party but the Tories still trail Labour and Reform in opinion polls.

stories.title: Trump approved the military's 1st firing squad execution since WWII. Why now?
stories.description: The Pentagon says Nidal Hasan will be executed by firing squad in December at Fort Hood, where he killed 13 people in 2009. The announcement came days after a botched lethal injection in Tennessee.

stories.title: Badenoch says Tories would scrap inheritance tax on family homes
stories.description: Tory leader says her party is "coming back", as she aims to convince voters it has changed after 2024 election defeat.

stories.title: Why Trump just loosened the rules on 'dyed diesel' — normally a farm fuel
stories.description: Trump is temporarily allowing this fuel to be used on highways, although it's typically just for off-road farm and construction vehicles. Could that lower the price of diesel?

stories.title: Ultra-Orthodox rabbi’s anti-Zionist remarks stir Israel election row
stories.description: Rabbi Dov Lando's comments expose tensions over Zionism, conscription and Netanyahu's ultra-Orthodox allies.

stories.title: Witnesses spot Eritrean troops inside northern Ethiopia as tensions flare
stories.description: Eritrea dismisses allegation as Ethiopia's pretext for more war.

stories.title: At least 24 killed as Russia launches massive attack on Ukraine
stories.description: Ukraine says Russia launched a massive overnight barrage of 130 drones, 48 cruise missiles and ballistic missiles

stories.title: Kenya on high alert amid concern over screening after first Ebola death
stories.description: Kenya’s government has intensified Ebola preparedness efforts amid growing concern over lapses in border screening.

stories.title: Trump to speak to Putin about plague lab worker's death in Russia
stories.description: Fears that the death may have been caused by pneumonic plague has prompted calls for more transparency from Russia.

stories.title: France halts use of stun grenades after boy's hand blown off in student protests
stories.description: The step comes after several groups complained of police using disproportionate force towards teenagers.

stories.title: Microsoft and Nvidia are teaming up on a supercharged AI laptop
stories.description: Powered by Nvidia’s RTX Spark chip, the latest Windows laptop is designed to run AI models and workloads directly on the device.

stories.title: Microsoft to sell $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing Nvidia AI chip
stories.description: The new device shows Microsoft remains committed to making its own PCs even though it's not one of the top device makers.

stories.title: Supertanker chartered from Gulf Coast to China for $76 million, 10 times higher than pre-war level
stories.description: Shipping costs have exploded as the war in the Persian Gulf has led to a shortage of available tankers.

stories.title: 10-year Treasury yield backs off from 24-year high after solid bond auction eases demand fears
stories.description: U.S. Treasury yields came off their highs after a solid sale of 10-year notes.

stories.title: Fed officials see another hike coming, but no sign as to when, minutes show
stories.description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its Sept. 15-16 policy meeting.

stories.title: Stocks are increasingly their own best hedge. This chart shows why.
stories.description: For decades, investors concerned about stocks sought succor in the bond market. But these days, the best shield against an outbreak of volatility might just be owning other stocks.

stories.description: Baltimore is reportedly sending Philadelphia a 2027 fifth-round pick and a 2028 second-rounder for Jurgens and a 2027 seventh-round pick
